configure_rich_logging: configure python logging to use RichHandler with rich tracebacks enabled at INFO level
get_logger: get a logging Logger instance for a given Python module with basicConfig already applied
review_configure_rich_logging: review the configure_rich_logging function to verify RichHandler is set up with rich tracebacks
test_get_logger: test the get_logger function by passing a module and verifying it returns a Logger instance
refactor_get_logger: refactor the get_logger function to accept a string module name instead of a ModuleType object
